title: SANDHI artifact: Fine-Grained Merging for Memory Efficient Multi-Model Serving (SOSP 2026)
description: Artifact for the SOSP 2026 paper "SANDHI: Fine-Grained Merging for Memory Efficient Multi-Model Serving". Contains the merging pipeline (gaussian profiling, component clustering, MICR merge-and-evaluate, memory/accuracy analysis; Figure 5), the serving benchmark harness with per-scenario merge specs and recorded reference runs for all five deployment scenarios (Figure 6), recorded offloading experiments, full-dataset accuracy evidence with raw evaluation outputs, and paper-style plotting scripts. Both pipelines run in prebuilt Docker images pinned by digest; see README.md and CHANGES.md.
